Hi Antim,

Following up on the quote we discussed last week. The finance team wants the Q3 numbers locked before the board pack goes out.

Thanks,
Priya

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the nudge. I am waiting on one input from our supplier and should have the revised sheet by tomorrow.
Thanks for the call earlier. Can you confirm the revised numbers by Friday? If the discount changes we need to re-run the approval.
We are blocked on the sandbox credentials. Our engineers have been idle for two days and the pilot date is at risk.
Any update? Happy to jump on a quick call if that is faster.
